chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Whoever loves to live a life resembling the lives of the Prophets, to die a death resembling the deaths of the martyrs, and to dwell in the Gardens which the All-beneficent has planted — then let him take Ali as his guardian, be loyal to his friends, and follow the Imams after him.
For indeed they are my progeny, created from my essence.
O God! Grant them my understanding and my knowledge. And woe to those of my community who oppose them! O God! Do not let them attain my intercession!

key_terms.شَفَاعَة: Intercession on the Day of Judgment; the Prophet's ability to intercede for his community
key_terms.طِينَة: Clay or primordial essence; the concept that the Imams share the Prophet's spiritual substance
key_terms.عِتْرَة: Progeny/family of the Prophet; in Shia theology specifically denotes the Fourteen Infallibles
key_terms.وَلِي: Guardian, loyal friend, protector; in this context the one who accepts Ali's authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about following Imam Ali and the Imams to attain the life of prophets and death of martyrs?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) narrates this hadith from the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW), in which the Prophet links three sublime aspirations — the life of prophets, the death of martyrs, and residence in paradise — to a single condition: devotion to Imam Ali, loyalty to his followers, and obedience to the Imams after him. The Prophet declares the Imams to be his progeny (عترة) created from his essence, and invokes God to grant them his own comprehension and knowledge. The tradition closes with a prophetic curse against those who oppose the Imams, and a prayer that they be deprived of prophetic intercession on the Day of Judgment.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Hameed, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Sa’ad Bin Tareyf, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘

The one who loves it that he should live a life resembling the lives of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and he should be dying a death resembling the deaths of the martyrs, and he settles in the Gardens which the Beneficent has Grown, so let him befriend Ali<sup>asws</sup>, and let him befriend his<sup>asws</sup> friends, and let him follow the Imams<sup>asws</sup> who (would come) after him<sup>asws</sup>,
for they<sup>asws</sup> are my<sup>saww</sup> family, having been Created from my<sup>saww</sup> essence.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Grace them<sup>asws</sup> my<sup>saww</sup> understanding, and my<sup>saww</sup> knowledge; and woe be unto the adversaries of theirs<sup>asws</sup> from my<sup>saww</sup> community! O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not let them attain my<sup>saww</sup> intercession!’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn Yahya have narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn ’Abd al-Hamid from Mansur ibn Yunus from Sa’d ibn Tarayf from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has narrated the following from the Holy Prophet (s.a.).

“Whoever would like to live a life similar to those of the prophets, die in a similar manner as the martyrs do and live in the garden which is planted by the Beneficent, they must love Imam Ali (a.s.) (acknowledge his Divine authority) and love those who love and support him and follow the Imams after him who are of my family and are created of the substance that I was created.
O Lord, give them my understand and knowledge. Send those of my people to Wayl (a place in Hell) who oppose them and do not give them the chance to benefit from my intervention on their behalf.
